description: Header file defining the QbonePacketExchanger class for handling packet exchange over QBONE connection in QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: QbonePacketExchanger
classes.description: Handles reading and writing packets between local network and QBONE connection, inherits from QbonePacketWriter.

classes.name: Visitor
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications on read/write errors.

methods.name: ReadAndDeliverPacket
methods.description: Reads a packet from the local network and delivers it to the qbone_client.

methods.name: WritePacketToNetwork
methods.description: Writes a packet to the local network, queues if blocked.

methods.name: SetWritable
methods.description: Indicates that the local network is no longer blocked.
